text_block_list.text:
The deserted island project is also progressing smoothly.
Then, one day—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: PR promotional photos?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Aaah! The great outdoors and the unleashing of wild instincts!
I know putting it into words
doesn't really do it justice!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
So, I need your help!
We're gonna share photos of life on this island!
'Cause seein' is believin', after all~!

It makes me pause and think for a moment.
Because it really felt like Gold City was truly relaxing on this island.
choice_data_list: (And yet, talking about things that remind her of work...)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
I'll go give it my all.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you're on camera duty, okay?
Come on, let's go.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Let's start around here, I guess...
The beautiful ocean is a great selling point after all.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'll be training like always,
so just take photos whenever you want, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Are you sure you want me to take the photo?
Are you sure you want me to take the photo?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, don't worry about being a novice or anything.
Yeah. Looking forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, gasp*...!
(Splash!)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Phew.
Yep, this place really is great.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I just hope the photo doesn't spread and make them too popular.
choice_data_list: ...Shall we delete the photos we took?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"No, it's fine.
Leave it as is."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...You took the photo because
you thought it looked nice, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the fo—ah, sorry.
You don't need to film, just go ahead and eat normally too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Camp food could also
make for a pretty good selling point, though.
I snapped a single photo of her smiling with the food in hand, then set the camera down.

Truly, she's picture-perfect whenever I shoot.
Even unpretentious daily life looks gorgeous on her.
It takes my breath away in sheer admiration.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Hey.
Show me the photos.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: ...Why did you have me take the picture?
...Why did you have me take the picture?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...I've been thinking about it this whole time.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ever since Yukino called me "pretty."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yukino told me,
"Taking it all together, you're just beautiful."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to see if it was true.
To see if I could believe it myself.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I borrowed your eyes.
The eyes of someone who knows everything about me—"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: —I'm pretty, aren't I?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Even though I totally forgot about the camera... Even though I had such a goofy, relaxed look on my face.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
“Still... it's genuinely 'pretty.'
Saying there's nothing on the inside was a total lie.”
choice_data_list: It's all because you've worked hard on both.
It's all because you've worked hard on both.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Mm.
With results like this, there's no room for doubt.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
This "beauty" is something you can only have
if you give your absolute all to both modeling and racing.
choice_data_list: You've always been unwaveringly beautiful, even until now.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Fuha, don't just say that to my face.
...I know.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—What's beautiful is beautiful.
I can finally admit that to myself now.
